exercises.json: a second's pause at the bottom, the chest under tension
docs/research/grip.md, 2.1: a press loads the palm heel along the forearm

lines.says: the elbows open to near straight at the top and close deep at the bottom, the hands beside the chest
the hips stay on the pad
the head stays on the pad
the shoulders stay pinned to the pad
the hands press on a near-straight line
the upper arms keep their angle to the trunk: no tuck and flare mid-rep
a bell never rocks mid-rep: its tilt runs evenly from the top to the bottom
a bell never spins about its handle
the wrist gives under the load, never rigid
the hand's roll runs evenly through the rep
at the bottom the forearms stand about upright under the bells
at the bottom the elbows hang below the pad, the bells beside the chest
the bells press up over the shoulders, not over the face or the belly
